Join us in disrupting real estate insurance!

Honeycomb was founded to disrupt an industry that was long overdue for modernization. Every employee is an integral part of bringing this change to life, no matter their role or department. While technology is an important enabler, as our CTO and co-founder Nimrod Sadot says, "AI technology is only as good as the brain behind it". Our unique strength lies in our team, united by a big-picture goal that we all support - we win together.
